claims.statement: Alarm lot LOT-1239 on DEP02-A measured 509.94 exceeds control limits 493.0-507.0 triggering OOC
Re-measurement of LOT-1239 on MET01 is 509.58 with in_control false confirming real thickness not MET02 misread
Prior DEP02-A measured lots in 24h were LOT-1229 499.59 and LOT-1233 500.38 and LOT-1224 501.58 all in control showing isolated spike
DEP02-A thickness slope is 0.242 per 100 wafers with mean_before_pm 500.873 and mean_after_pm 502.297 indicating no upward drift after PM at 57.46
FDC heater_temp_C recent z_score 0.9 delta 0.16 and recent measured wafers include 499.59 and 500.38 showing no real heater change
Commonality ANOVA p-values CLEAN 0.5286 DEP 0.407 MET 0.6951 not significant ruling out upstream or chamber systematic shift

disposition.summary: Single-wafer OOC at 509.94 confirmed at 509.58 on alternate metrology is isolated; prior DEP02-A wafers around 499.59-501.58 and flat slope 0.242 per 100 wafers show chamber on target, FDC shows no heater excursion, indicating one-off wafer variation.
